x: Our other competitors were Holtum, 3rd in the 100yds, and Pepe and Edwards 4th in the 880 yds. and javelin respectively. In recognition of our winning the trophy for three successive years, Carshalton Council made a nice gesture by presenting us with a special plaque.
Pride of place must go to our 4x440 yds Senior relay team of P.Pepe, C.Coxall, C.Jones and G.Leroy who, running in that order, defeated the holders, Epsom and Ewell Harriers, in 3m.28.3s.

Pepe started rather fast into the mud while Brian Morris and Frank Wright went off steadily. At the half-way mark Brian was leading slightly from Frank, but Pepe and "Jacko" found the heavy grass track not to their liking and decided to save their energies for the relay.
